message:
Coach v12: Big weekend. Incline 235x5 (up from x4) + 195x8x2, Incline DB beat target (85x10,9,9), Pulldown 192x8x2 and Pull-Ups +55x7 hit, Straight-Arm FST-7 112x12 on all 7. Every Coach target hit except Machine Dip.
Fix: FST-7 means ONE weight for all 7. Pec Deck went 132>120>108. Next time 120 all 7.
Food is the weak link: logged days are 700-1,700 kcal vs 3,300. Eat and log all 6 meals, 270 g protein minimum. Added swaps for what you actually eat: Eggs + protein toast, and Fast chicken + rice. No extra cardio until food is logged.
Week B now opens with the weak point: Sat Incline Machine Press first, Sun Underhand Pulldown first.
Mon/Thu: rest + 35 min Z2 walk. Tue: DB Press 70s, Laterals FST-7 110, lat feeder. Wed: upper-chest feeder + arms. Fri: RDL opens.
Daily: vacuums AM + PM, walk 10 min after meals, Z2 115-130 bpm. Sun: fasted photos in shorter shorts (missed today).

mwcf199p1iw2a.note: Beat target: 85x10,9,9. Next 10,10,9. 15-30 deg, forearms vertical, shy of lockout.

mwcf199pa5hsk.note: Baseline 160x9 at the end of a ramp. Straight sets at 150 for 10. Chin up.

mwch4fbvgkoiq.note: Sat 23x12 all sets. +1 rep. Lowest pulley, pinkies up to chin, pause-squeeze.

mwcf199pucr7t.note: Week B opener now. 192x8x2 Sun: 172 for 10-12. Underhand, one fluid motion, blades into back pocket. Rest-pause the last set.

mwch4fbvjcfcm.note: Baseline 115x8. Two work sets at 115, pause at the top, chest glued to pad.

mwcf199ppo3wa.note: Tue lat feeder (skipped Sun). Pick a DB for 12/arm. Supinated, elbow to hip pocket, shoulder down, no shrug.

mwcf199pj1j8a.note: Tue lat feeder: 2 sets, 2 reps in reserve. Sun FST-7 went 112x12 all 7: Sun target goes up Wed. Chest down, spread hands past hips.

mwcf199pqrb69.note: FST-7, 35 s rest. Hold 110 until all 7 hit 12. Flex delts 10 to 30 s between sets, ~2 oz water.

mwcf199phclse.note: +1 rep per set, then add weight.

mwk3zv2spojaf.note: Last 30x8. Full stretch at the bottom.

mwk3zv2snxssw.note: Now 2 hard straight sets. Last 60x10: +1 rep.

mwk3zv2s7ijz3.note: Now 2 hard straight sets. Last 112x12: own it on both.

mwcf199p92ng5.note: 140x5 last time (e1RM up ~15% in a week). Own 140 across sets before 145.

mwcf199pwjnp2.note: Hit 15s across: load up. Pause at the face.

mwcf199pjpfzl.note: Recomp range 10-12. Last 475x8. High-wide feet for hams/glutes, deep, no lockout.

mwch4fbvt8g1b.note: 75x8 was easy: add a plate step.

mwch4fbvi9k95.note: Wed upper-chest feeder: 2 reps in reserve, no grinding. Chin up.

mwch4fbud70m5.note: Last 192x8, 212x5. Own 192 for 9. Elbows ~45 deg, chest up, traps quiet.

mwch4fbve5rav.note: Hold 130, +1-2 reps per set. All 4 at 12 = add weight.

mwcf199pj80xr.note: Optional standing calves. Last 345x13. Full stretch, 1 s pause up top.

mwcf199pwvijb.note: New. Pick a load for 12, hips pinned, slow negative.

mwcf199p99on5.note: New. Weight = per-hand DB. 12 per leg, long stride, torso slightly forward.

mwk3zv2s3oo4u.note: Optional 1 set if time. Pick a load for 15, strict.

mwcf199plneh9.note: Bodyweight, lean forward, deep stretch. If 12 is easy, add load next time.

meals.name: Breakfast
meals.notes: Before work. Cook the oats in the microwave with the berries. Heavy days (Fri-Sun): add 1 banana. 10-min walk after.

meals.name: Mid-morning
meals.notes: Desk-friendly. Pack it the night before.

meals.name: Lunch
meals.notes: Meal-prep box. Batch-cook chicken Sun + Wed. Heavy days (Fri-Sun): rice to 2 cups. Rest days (Mon/Thu): rice to 1 cup. 10-min walk after.

meals.name: Pre-workout
meals.notes: 60-90 min before lifting, low fat. Rest days (Mon/Thu): skip the rice cakes and honey, keep the shake and banana.

meals.name: Dinner
meals.notes: Post-workout meal. Salmon swap 2x a week. Potato or sweet potato, your pick. 10-min walk after. Fri + Sat: extra carbs (rice/potato) + teriyaki or ketchup, extra water to fill out Sat chest and Sun back.

groceries: Chicken breast 8 lb raw (Costco Kirkland pack)
Eggs 2 dozen + liquid egg whites 2 x 32 oz
Jasmine rice 10 lb bag (or microwave cups)
Optional: 96% lean ground beef 2 lb, deli turkey, tortillas
Psyllium husk, creatine, vitamin D3, fish oil (restock)

cardio.notes: Mon + Thu rest days (morning or after work), Sat after chest. After lifting or fasted AM. Max 45 min/session; add a 2nd session rather than going longer.
Rest days: before work or after dinner. After lifting or fasted AM. Max 45 min/session; add a 2nd session rather than going longer.
Right after lifting. After lifting or fasted AM. Max 45 min/session; add a 2nd session rather than going longer.
Cut phase cardio: workdays + Saturday post-lift. After lifting or fasted AM. Max 45 min/session; add a 2nd session rather than going longer.
Right after Friday legs to flush the legs. After lifting or fasted AM. Max 45 min/session; add a 2nd session rather than going longer.
Empty stomach. Exhale fully, closed-throat fake inhale, navel to spine. Start on hands and knees: 5 x 10-20 s holds, 30 s rest. Stand once 5 x 20 s is clean.
Evening, 2+ h after a meal. Same as AM: exhale fully, closed-throat fake inhale, navel to spine, 5 x 10-20 s on hands and knees.
2-3x/week, 5 min max. No weighted side bends or heavy twists.

all.name: Overhead Press
all.notes: Ramp up with 2-3 light sets (don't log them). Target 115×8 on the top set, then go to 120. Brace hard, squeeze glutes, bar over mid-foot.

all.name: Seated DB Press
all.notes: You're pre-fatigued from overhead press. Use 55s and own all 3 sets; go up when every set hits 10.

all.name: Face Pull
all.notes: Start around 117 and build to 132+. Pull to the forehead, elbows high, hold 1s.

all.name: Reverse Pec Deck
all.notes: Use 180 for all 3 sets. When all 3 hit 15, add weight. No swinging, lead with the elbows.

all.name: Lateral Raise
all.notes: Start around 105-110, strict, no trap shrug. FST-7: one weight all 7 sets, 10-12 reps, 30-45 s rest. Between sets FLEX/pose the target 10 s, building to 30 s (no stretching during the 7s). Sip ~2 oz water before and after each flex.

quads.name: Back Squat
quads.notes: Top set after ramp-ups (warm-ups not logged), then back-offs about 15-20% lighter. Control the negative.

quads.name: Hack Squat
quads.notes: Feet low and narrow, flat shoes. 4 s down, zero bounce, stop shy of lockout. 1 top set + 2 back-offs.

quads.name: Romanian Deadlift
quads.notes: Hinge, bar close, stop at mid-shin stretch.

quads.name: Seated Leg Curl
quads.notes: Lean forward, pause at full contraction.

quads.name: Leg Extension
quads.notes: 3 hard straight sets (FST-7 is off quads this block). 1 s squeeze, last set to failure + bottom partials.

hamstrings.name: Romanian Deadlift
hamstrings.notes: Top set after ramp-ups (warm-ups not logged), then back-offs about 15-20% lighter. Control the negative.

hamstrings.name: Leg Press
hamstrings.notes: Feet high and wide. Full depth, no bounce.

hamstrings.name: Seated Leg Curl
hamstrings.notes: 3 hard straight sets. Lean forward, pause at full contraction, last set to failure.

calves.name: Seated Calf Raise
calves.notes: Full stretch, 1 s pause at the bottom.

calves.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
calves.notes: Straight knees, pause at the bottom.

upper.name: Incline Bench Press
upper.notes: Top set after ramp-ups (warm-ups not logged), then back-offs about 15-20% lighter. Control the negative.

upper.name: Incline DB Press
upper.notes: 15-30 deg bench, elbows 45-60 deg, forearms vertical. Deep stretch, stop shy of lockout. Neutral grip on alternate weeks.

upper.name: Machine Chest Press
upper.notes: Chin up, chest proud (tucking the chin cuts the range). 2 reps in reserve.

upper.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
upper.notes: Lowest pulley, fixed soft elbows, pinkies up, scoop to chin height. Touch, don't cross. Pause-squeeze every rep.

upper.name: Pec Deck
upper.notes: 1 s squeeze, chest up. FST-7: one weight all 7 sets, 10-12 reps, 30-45 s rest. Between sets FLEX/pose the target 10 s, building to 30 s (no stretching during the 7s). Sip ~2 oz water before and after each flex.

mid.name: Bench Press
mid.notes: Top set after ramp-ups (warm-ups not logged), then back-offs about 15-20% lighter. Control the negative.

mid.name: Cable Fly
mid.notes: 3 hard straight sets (FST-7 lives on Pec Deck this block). 1 s squeeze, hands meet, don't cross.

lower.name: Incline Machine Press
lower.notes: Upper-chest feeder first, while fresh. Low incline, chin up, chest proud, stop shy of lockout. 2 reps in reserve, no grinding.

lower.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
lower.notes: Feeder. Lowest pulley, fixed soft elbows, pinkies up to chin height, touch don't cross, pause-squeeze.

lower.name: Barbell Curl
lower.notes: Superset A1 with Skull Crusher. Strict elbows, no sway.

lower.name: Skull Crusher
lower.notes: Superset A2 with Barbell Curl. Lower behind head for long-head stretch.

lower.name: Incline DB Curl
lower.notes: Superset B1 with Overhead Cable Extension. Full bottom stretch.

lower.name: Overhead Cable Extension
lower.notes: Superset B2 with Incline DB Curl. Elbows tucked, full stretch.

lower.name: Preacher Curl
lower.notes: 2 hard straight sets (FST-7 is off arms this block). 1 s squeeze, last set to failure + partials.

lower.name: Rope Pushdown
lower.notes: 2 hard straight sets. Split the rope at the bottom, last set to failure + partials.

upper.name: Lat Pulldown
upper.notes: Opener, underhand grip. 2 x 8, then rest-pause: set 1 one rest-pause, set 2 two rest-pauses (10-15 s each, max reps). Blades into your back pocket, one fluid pull, don't over-arch. No straps until top sets. Log the 8s; rest-pause reps are bonus.

upper.name: Pull-Up
upper.notes: Weight = added load. After the pulldown opener now, so a touch lighter. Full hang, chest to bar. No straps until top sets.

upper.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
upper.notes: Pause 1 s at the top, no hip drive.

upper.name: Single-Arm DB Row
upper.notes: Supinated high row: elbow to the hip pocket, shoulder down, no shrug. Long stretch at the bottom.

upper.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
upper.notes: Double rope, 45 deg hinge, chest down, soft fixed elbows, spread the rope past the hips, bottom partials on the last reps. FST-7: one weight all 7 sets, 10-12 reps, 30-45 s rest. Between sets FLEX/pose the target 10 s, building to 30 s (no stretching during the 7s). Sip ~2 oz water before and after each flex.

mid.name: Lat Pulldown
mid.notes: Underhand close grip. Blades into your back pocket, one fluid pull, don't over-arch.

mid.name: Barbell Row
mid.notes: Top set after ramp-ups (warm-ups not logged), then back-offs about 15-20% lighter. Control the negative.

mid.name: Seated Cable Row
mid.notes: 3 hard straight sets. Elbows to the hip pockets, shoulders down, no shrug. 1 s squeeze.

mid.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
mid.notes: Double rope, 45 deg hinge, chest down, soft fixed elbows, spread the rope past the hips, bottom partials on the last reps. FST-7: one weight all 7 sets, 10-12 reps, 30-45 s rest. Between sets FLEX/pose the target 10 s, building to 30 s (no stretching during the 7s). Sip ~2 oz water before and after each flex.

lower.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
lower.notes: Tue lat feeder (not FST-7). Double rope, 45 deg hinge, chest down, soft fixed elbows, spread the rope past the hips, bottom partials on the last reps. Stop 2 reps shy of failure. Skip the feeder if lats are still sore from Sunday.

lower.name: Single-Arm DB Row
lower.notes: Tue lat feeder, reps per arm. Supinated high row: elbow to the hip pocket, shoulder down, no shrug. Long stretch at the bottom. Moderate load, no heavy rows.

lower.name: Reverse Curl
lower.notes: Optional. Skip it if you're past 45 min.

side.name: Seated DB Press
side.notes: Short-day press. Full depth, no bounce.

side.name: Lateral Raise
side.notes: Strict, lead with the elbows, no trap shrug. FST-7: one weight all 7 sets, 10-12 reps, 30-45 s rest. Between sets FLEX/pose the target 10 s, building to 30 s (no stretching during the 7s). Sip ~2 oz water before and after each flex.

side.name: Reverse Pec Deck
side.notes: Rear delts for width and posture.

front.name: Overhead Press
front.notes: Top set after ramp-ups (warm-ups not logged), then back-offs about 15-20% lighter. Control the negative.

front.name: Machine Lateral Raise
front.notes: Straight sets. FST-7 laterals live on Tue side-delt day.

biceps.name: Barbell Curl
biceps.notes: Superset with Skull Crusher on short days.

biceps.name: Preacher Curl
biceps.notes: 3 hard straight sets, 1 s squeeze, last set to failure + partials.

triceps.name: Rope Pushdown
triceps.notes: 3 hard straight sets, split the rope at the bottom, last set to failure + partials.

all.notes: Superset B1 with Overhead Cable Extension. Full bottom stretch.
